verified: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as reported by Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (Planet GTA 6, 18 Nov 2026); the visible/hidden split comes from the same cross-check: 27 visible, 28 hidden. Strategy notes live in app/guides.js; the status of each method (confirmed / reported / unconfirmed) is tracked there.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last one to land: collect the other 54 and this follows on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the mission that opens the story, to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through; do the balcony meditation before the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: See Chapter 2 through; both protagonists become playable here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: See Chapter 3 through; the map opens wide from here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: See Chapter 4 through; the optional vault mission appears in this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to the end — and save manually just before it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child’s Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion; check Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of the 397 in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s mission strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s mission strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s mission strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Strangers & Freaks strands across Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s mission strand — it unlocks the Key Cloner.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s mission strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots; the balcony one must happen in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret names.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan with WAiNK at 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level with your partner and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with WAiNK.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies in a single Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing plane at VCIA and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and use it in combat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the nine gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view — method still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee in south Vice City and drive it through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take the three valuables from the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max Strength for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reach 500 actions on your Criminal Profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt — exact trigger still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the strange encounter in Kelly County after 2am — reported, unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — method still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
